title: Girl Meets Rock!
description:
With a passion for richly textured Japanese rock, first-year high school student Chihiro Hatono steps into the world of the light music club, new guitar in tow. But what awaits her behind those doors...?
___
**Award:** Won the 10th Next Manga Awards Web Category (2024).

**Official English Volumes:** [Seven Seas](https://sevenseasentertainment.com/series/girl-meets-rock/)

title: Father, Unrivaled
description:
Noh Gajang is a strong, dedicated, and humble man, with much respect for the martial arts. But after the death of his lovely wife, this muscle-for-hire just wants an easy job that allows him to be a good father to his three little babies. He’s even happy to pull guard duty and fend off amateur fighters if it means he can return home safely each night. 

But when a creepy cult starts stealing children from the city, Gajang must step up to the challenge and discover his true warrior potential.

title: Gray Part-Time Jobs: No Escape
description:
Ura baito, also known as a shady part-time job: a gray area job that pays very well. The price you pay is your life. Yume Kokuryo and Nagomi Shirahama are seeking a large sum of money for some reason. To that end, they casually dive into various shady part-time jobs.
___
This work may affect you physically and mentally. Read it at your own risk. We are not responsible for any damage to your health.

title: DIG IT
description: Gaku is the son of former Japanese national volleyball star Kei Shishiya. Through middle school, he’s played as his team’s ace hitter, though part of him wonders if that’s a title he earned, or one he was simply given. One day, Kei meets Noboru, a generational volleyball talent with a monstrous spiking arm, and vows to turn him into the next national standout. In the wake of that choice, Gaku realizes he can’t play the style his father demands, but swears he’ll defeat both Kei and Noboru with a game that’s entirely his own.

title: Rock 'n Roll
description:
High school students Mayama and Sayama. They’re childhood friends and best friends—the two of them do everything together. But lately, it seems like Sayama has been getting a lot of attention…?

Inseparable Childhood Friends: Signs of Change in Their Everyday Lives

title: Nijisanji - Ebimaru Misadventures (Doujinshi)
description: A short webcomic series detailing the misadventures between Ex Albio and Ars Almal. Compilation of webcomics by 筆たらず (@LLVPunQEFDXM7wI)) (No official name)

title: Devilman
description:
Demons exist and their power is beyond what humans can fathom. In fact they are so strong that humans do not stand a chance against them in a fight. The only thing strong enough to defeat a demon is another demon and it is through this logic that Ryo Asuka hatches the plan to have his good-hearted friend Akira Fudo possessed by a demon. If a person is of pure of heart then he might be able to control the demon that possesses him and thereby acquire power equal to a demon. After raising some hell in a club the plan works and Akira is possessed by the powerful demon known as Amon. Now Akira is mankind's sole champion of justice against the hidden demon menace that has plagued humanity since the dawn of time.

[Official English](https://sevenseasentertainment.com/series/devilman-the-classic-collection/)

title: Ochibi-chan from Another World Creates Something Again Today ~ Using the Skill [Imagination Creation] to Aim for Success! ~"
description: One day, Ochibi (5 years old) who lives in the slums suddenly remembers that she has been reincarnated from another world. Ochibi has the "Imagination Creation" skill, which allows her to create anything she imagines. She decides to start a business with the Japanese items she obtains with her "Imagination Creation" skill! A heartwarming story with a boy named "Onii" and a girl named "Nene" who aim to escape the slums!!

title: Imaizumi Brings All the Gals to His House
description: During the day, Imaizumi attends his classes like any dutiful student, only to return each evening to a home full of hotties! It seems his home has become the go-to hangout for the coolest gyarus in town. From endless gossip fests to snack binges to getting downright physical with his three new housemates, his once-quiet abode is now buzzing with non-stop energy and exciting escapades. Can Imaizumi keep up with the lively antics of his lusty gal pals?

title: Mentori-Sama
description:
Summer vacation in my third year of college. A stiflingly hot countryside home. A dark storehouse that must never be entered.
My grandmother keeps muttering the same thing over and over: ‘Mentori-sama is watching.’
But it’s fine because I have my big sister.
A chilling folk-horror tale of blood ties and buried customs begins.

title: I'm Sick and Tired of My Childhood Friend's, Now Girlfriend's, Constant Abuse, so I Broke up With Her
description: My childhood friend is also my girlfriend. A dream come true, right? Hell no. She insults me on a daily basis. She grinds my dignity into shreds and it takes a toll on my mental well-being. I can't take it anymore. So I'm left with no choice, I'm going to break up with her. In order to maintain my sanity, it's the only option.

title: Depravity Absolute
description:
The world of Srko is one full of sin and death. The nations of the Middle Lands fight for survival while the Scorch Crows, lead by Dioneese, slowly conquer their land as their own. The kings of the lands yet to be conquered fear that their kingdoms are next in line to be absorbed into the territories taken under the pressing grip of the crow’s talons.

The brother-in-law of Dioneese is a purple lizardman named Whacks Wangsworth. He’s short, very short, and isn’t the brightest. But when his wife is kidnapped by Dioneese, her own brother, Whacks sees to it that he leaves his two adopted daughters in search of his captive wife. One of these daughters, named Starlight, secretly follows him, and befriends a tall, otherworldly warrior named Lord D. These three unknowingly have found their spirits entangled in a cosmic plan so beyond their understanding that what they see in the physical realm, and what Lord D has seen in the spirit realm, doesn’t even show a sliver of a fraction of what they are about to experience. Death, kingdoms against kingdoms, war, famine, and the ever-present weight of the stench of absolute depravity tainting every thought, word, and deed of every mortal on the surfaces of the three layers of creation. This inability to do good, this absolute depravity that stains the spirits of every mortal being from the time of their conception, is unknown to most. Those who do know of its presence think of it in various ways. For some, such as Lord D, it’s an inevitability, a dark and depressing truth of the world they live in. For others, like Whacks, it is a passive truth, but true nonetheless; something to be apathetic towards as long as a goal is in mind. But for some, like Starlight, the weight is greater than anything in creation. Yet they know of a hope to come, a divine truth that contrasts the stain of this inherited sin, that makes the ugly form of absolute depravity seem as nothing in comparison.

Alas, this hope is forgotten to time, only remembered by a select few. But to those who do know of this hope, they know the truth…

The day of sacrifice is near.
The story of creation is nearing its end.

title: Mao
description:
Onmyoji and Yokai? A girl's bizarre Taisho romance! When she was in the first grade of elementary school, her whole family was involved in an accident, but she is the only one who survived. In her third year of junior high school, she passes by the accident site again and is somehow transported back to the Taisho Era! The next day, Nanoka's physical abilities are awakened when she is told by Mao, a boy she met there who is an Onmyoji, "You are a demon, aren't you?"
___
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by [Elex Media](https://www.gramedia.com/products/mao-01) (2021)

title: Zettai Karen Children
description: It's the 21st century, and the number of ESPers continues to increase. They are active in the military, diplomacy, politics, and in other places. They hold the key for global competition. A country that controls ESP can control the world! However individuals who posses higher than Level 4 are less than 3% of the population. There are only three Level 7 people who have government contracts. These three are Kaoru, Aoi, and Shiho, ten-year old girls, who work for B.A.B.E.L. With the guidance of Kouichi, a twenty-year old genius, they catch criminals and evil ESPers.

title: A Big Rabbit has Taken a Liking to Me!?
description: A new member of the workforce, the night before his first day... Hajime Ogami is so nervous he can’t sleep. Plagued by anxiety over whether he can make it in the distant, unfamiliar city of Fukuoka, Hajime heads out for a midnight stroll. There, he is accosted by a strangely over-familiar, "giant" drunk woman, and the two of them end up heading out into the "city at night" together...!?

title: Yuru Yuri
description: Four mischievous girls illegally occupy the former Traditional Tea Ceremony clubroom, in order to create the "Amusement Club." These scamps…who ignore repeated warnings—in direct rebellion with the righteous directives of the Student Council—decide to remain in the room until they finally get off their bums and do something! In this slightly sluggish manga, full of fits and starts, the four girls set off from their homes for a walk together with days full of a little this and that!

title: Fabulous Beasts
description:
"In this realm mythological creatures roam, descendant of the nine heavens they call home." 

Sibuxiang, a mythical deer-man couch potato, is kicked out of heaven and assigned to support the mythological creatures wandering the human world. He meets and goes on adventures with his friends: the energetic, food loving Pixiu named Pipi, the fanatic moon bunny Tuye, the banished-from-heaven mouse brothers Jinjiao and Yinjiao, and many others. What kind of adventures will they take on?

title: The Marshal King
description:
Nobody on the continent hasn't heard of the evil deeds of the great outlaw M. Godspeed. But one day, a young man claiming to be the criminal's son suddenly appears trekking through the harsh desert. This Jim Godspeed says he's killed his father and has the corpse to prove it!

(Source: MangaPlus)

title: Let Me Be Single in Peace!
description:
Love, friendship, and a glorious adolescence—that's what Hodoka Nanamura hoped for when he entered high school. But by his final year, he had none of it. Then, on the eve of graduation, he sacrifices himself to save his classmate, Sora Hanamitsuji, from on oncoming truck, ending his life... or so it should have. Instead, he and Hanamitsuji were both transported back in time to their first year of high school, just before the entrance ceremony. Though Nanamura resigned himself to reliving the same unremarkable, lonely high school years, Hanamitsuji swears that she'll drag him out of his loner lifestyle!

*Source: Manga UP! Global*
